title: This startup thinks robotics is about to have its ChatGPT moment
slides: What if one robot could learn any task instantly?
This startup trains robots from internet video, not code.
Their model generalizes to objects it has never seen.
You will soon deploy fleets without months of reprogramming.
Stop assuming robots need custom software; test their demo.
thread_text:
1. One robot to rule them.

A startup just trained a single model on internet video — no task-specific code needed.

2. Generalization is the twist.

The robot picks up objects it has never seen, from mugs to screwdrivers.

3. Training shifts to watching.

Human teleoperation or simulation? Replaced by YouTube clips and Instagram reels.

4. Deployment becomes instant.

Fleets update from one shared model — no months of reprogramming per facility.

5. Test their demo today.

Visit their site, upload a short video, and see if the robot mimics it. Have you tried it yet?
